### **Job Description and Duties**

CalRecycle’s Office of Environmental Justice, Tribal Relations, Education and Outreach is seeking a Senior Environmental Scientist (Specialist) to serve as a lead technical expert on environmental justice and tribal-relations issues. The incumbent will conduct advanced scientific analyses, guide departmentwide integration of environmental justice and tribal priorities, and lead complex evaluations of program impacts on California Native American tribes, disadvantaged communities, low-income populations, rural communities, and farmworkers. This role independently designs studies, performs advanced fieldwork, develops best-practice guidance, and advises leadership on emerging environmental challenges and policy opportunities.
  
The Senior Environmental Scientist will coordinate cross-division efforts to ensure consistency in environmental justice implementation, provide specialized training to staff, prepare high-level technical reports and public-facing materials, and lead outreach and partnership-building efforts with tribes, community organizations, and statewide partners. In addition, the incumbent may lead and support aspects of grant and contract management, including development of equity-focused criteria, technical review of proposals, and monitoring of project performance to ensure alignment with environmental justice and tribal priorities.
  
Occasional statewide travel is required, and the position participates in the DMV Employer Pull Notice Program.This position offers the opportunity to shape statewide environmental programs, strengthen equitable access to grants, support community-centered engagement strategies, and advance youth environmental education initiatives.

Job Overview:

At the Metropolitan Water District of Southern California, we deliver reliable water to a region with 19 million people—and to accomplish this, we rely on a team of talented employees: innovators, problem-solvers, and collaborators who make it all possible.

There is currently one (1) opening for the **Information Technology GIS Analyst I** located in Los Angeles, CA.

This recruitment may result in an eligibility list.

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The **Information Technology GIS Analyst I** is an entry-level position that supports the organization’s Geographic Information System (GIS) and information technology operations. Under established guidelines and close supervision, this position develops practical experience in GIS technology, spatial data management, mapping, technical support, and data analysis.

The Information Technology Analyst I will assist with maintaining accurate and reliable GIS information, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, responding to technical questions, and creating maps, reports, and other visual products that help users understand and utilize geographic information. The position may also contribute to project teams, gaining exposure to GIS applications, data processing workflows, and technology-driven solutions to organizational needs.

**What** **You’ll** **Do**

* Provide technology and GIS support by troubleshooting hardware, software, GIS applications, and related technical issues; responds to customer questions and assists users in identifying practical solutions to technology and GIS-related needs.
* Contribute to GIS and technology projects by participating as a member of project teams, assisting with assigned tasks, coordinating project activities, and gaining hands-on experience with organizational GIS initiatives and technology solutions.
* Maintains and enhances GIS data by entering, updating, organizing, validating, and processing spatial and attribute information to support the accuracy, integrity, and usability of GIS databases and applications.
* Assists with GIS data processing and quality control by reviewing information for completeness and accuracy, identifying potential discrepancies, and supporting established procedures for maintaining reliable geographic data.
* Performs research and related technical tasks as assigned, helping to gather, organize, interpret, and present geographic and technology-related information in support of departmental operations.

The **Information Technology GIS Analyst I** is an entry-level position that supports the organization’s Geographic Information System (GIS) and information technology operations. The Information Technology Analyst I will assist with maintaining accurate and reliable GIS information, troubleshooting hardware and software issues, responding to technical questions, and creating maps, reports, and other visual products that help users understand and utilize geographic information.
